title: dryopteris thibetica
intro: Dryopteris thibetica, commonly known as Tibetan shield fern, is a type of fern species native to the Himalayan region. It is a medicinal plant known for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris thibetica include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as being used as a diuretic and a laxative. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
